definition: A thought or a plan that you have in your mind.
examples: That's a great idea!
I have no idea where my keys are.
Do you have any ideas for her birthday?

spanish.definition: Pensamiento o plan que tienes en la mente.

definition: More bad than any other person or thing.
examples: This is the worst movie I've ever seen.
Monday is the worst day of the week.
He played worst of all the boys.

spanish.definition: Más malo que cualquier otra persona o cosa.

definition: One of the flat green parts of a plant or tree.
examples: A leaf fell from the tree.
The leaves turn red in the fall.
This plant has very big leaves.

spanish.definition: Parte plana y verde de una planta o árbol.

definition: A flat board on a wall or in a closet where you put things.
examples: The books are on the top shelf.
Can you put the plates on the shelf?
We need more shelves in the kitchen.

spanish.definition: Tabla plana en una pared o armario para poner cosas.

definition: Bread baked in one large piece.
examples: I bought a loaf of bread.
She baked two loaves for the family.
This loaf is still warm.

spanish.definition: Pan horneado en una sola pieza grande.

definition: A young cow; the back part of your leg below the knee.
examples: The calf stayed near its mother.
My left calf hurts after the run.
The farmer has three new calves.

spanish.definition: Vaca joven; parte de atrás de la pierna debajo de la rodilla.

definition: The number 13.
examples: My sister is thirteen years old.
There are thirteen people in the room.
Some people think thirteen is an unlucky number.

spanish.definition: El número 13.

definition: The number 14.
examples: He started working at fourteen.
There are fourteen eggs in the box.
We stayed there for fourteen days.

spanish.definition: El número 14.

definition: The number 16.
examples: You can drive at sixteen in many states.
She turns sixteen next week.
I read sixteen pages last night.

spanish.definition: El número 16.

definition: The number 17.
examples: My brother is seventeen.
The bus leaves in seventeen minutes.
There are seventeen students in my class.

spanish.definition: El número 17.

definition: The number 18.
examples: You can vote at eighteen.
She left home when she was eighteen.
I paid eighteen dollars for lunch.

spanish.definition: El número 18.

definition: The number 19.
examples: He's only nineteen years old.
Nineteen people came to the party.
I got married at nineteen.

spanish.definition: El número 19.

definition: The number 20.
examples: I'll be there in twenty minutes.
Can I borrow twenty dollars?
She's twenty years old.

spanish.definition: El número 20.

definition: The number 40.
examples: My dad is forty years old.
It takes forty minutes to get there.
There are forty chairs in the room.

spanish.definition: El número 40.

definition: The number 60.
examples: There are sixty minutes in an hour.
My grandmother is over sixty.
The speed limit here is sixty miles per hour.

spanish.definition: El número 60.

definition: The number 70.
examples: My grandfather is seventy.
About seventy people work here.
The shoes cost seventy dollars.

spanish.definition: El número 70.

definition: The number 80.
examples: She lived to be eighty.
It was eighty degrees yesterday.
The book has eighty pages.

spanish.definition: El número 80.

definition: The number 90.
examples: A soccer game lasts ninety minutes.
He's almost ninety years old.
I got ninety percent on the test.

spanish.definition: El número 90.

definition: Number 7 in a series.
examples: We live on the seventh floor.
Saturday is the seventh day of the week.
My birthday is on the seventh of May.

spanish.definition: Número 7 en una serie.

definition: Number 8 in a series.
examples: My son is in eighth grade.
She finished in eighth place.
Today is the eighth of March.

spanish.definition: Número 8 en una serie.

definition: Number 9 in a series.
examples: It's our ninth year in this house.
The office is on the ninth floor.
The party is on the ninth of June.

spanish.definition: Número 9 en una serie.

definition: Number 10 in a series.
examples: This is my tenth cup of coffee this week!
He came in tenth in the race.
We leave on the tenth of July.

spanish.definition: Número 10 en una serie.

definition: A kind name for someone you love, like a child.
examples: Good night, sweetie.
Come here, sweetie, and eat your dinner.
Are you OK, sweetie?

spanish.definition: Nombre cariñoso para alguien que amas, como un niño.

definition: A word that children use for their mother.
examples: I want my mommy!
Mommy, can I have some juice?
Her mommy picks her up from school.

spanish.definition: Palabra que usan los niños para su madre.

definition: A place in the body where two bones meet; shared by two or more people.
examples: My knee joint hurts when it's cold.
We have a joint bank account.
It was a joint decision.

spanish.definition: Lugar del cuerpo donde se unen dos huesos; compartido por dos o más personas.

definition: Movies as an art; a place where you watch movies.
examples: She studies French cinema.
There's a small cinema near my house.
He loves old American cinema.

spanish.definition: Las películas como arte; lugar donde se ven películas.

definition: A small coin; there are 100 cents in a dollar.
examples: It costs ninety-nine cents.
I don't have a cent in my pocket.
This candy is only fifty cents.

spanish.definition: Moneda pequeña; hay 100 centavos en un dólar.

definition: A unit for measuring length; a machine that measures something.
examples: The pool is two meters deep.
She ran one hundred meters in thirteen seconds.
Put some coins in the parking meter.

spanish.definition: Unidad para medir la longitud; máquina que mide algo.

definition: A unit of weight equal to 2,000 pounds; a very large amount.
examples: The truck weighs ten tons.
I have tons of work today.
This bag weighs a ton!

spanish.definition: Unidad de peso igual a 2,000 libras; cantidad muy grande.

definition: Money saved for a special purpose; to give money for something.
examples: We have a fund for the children's school.
The city funds this program.
They started a fund to help the families.

spanish.definition: Dinero guardado para un fin especial; dar dinero para algo.

definition: A word children use for a rabbit.
examples: The little girl has a pet bunny.
Look at the white bunny in the yard!
My son sleeps with his toy bunny.

spanish.definition: Palabra que usan los niños para un conejo.

definition: A small phone that you carry with you.
examples: Please turn off your cellphone.
I left my cellphone at home.
What's your cellphone number?

spanish.definition: Teléfono pequeño que llevas contigo.

definition: Actions always done in the same way, often for religion.
examples: Coffee in the morning is my ritual.
The priest performed an old ritual.
They have a ritual before every game.

spanish.definition: Acciones hechas siempre igual, a menudo por religión.

definition: A very strong feeling of not liking someone or something.
examples: There was hatred in his eyes.
Hatred only brings more pain.
She spoke with hatred about her enemy.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento muy fuerte contra alguien o algo.

definition: Very beautiful or wonderful.
examples: It's a glorious day for a picnic.
We saw a glorious sunset.
The team had a glorious victory.

spanish.definition: Muy hermoso o maravilloso.

definition: A person who says they can know the future or read minds.
examples: She went to see a psychic.
I'm not psychic, so tell me what you want.
He says he has psychic powers.

spanish.definition: Persona que dice conocer el futuro o leer la mente.

definition: An informal word for technology.
examples: He works in tech.
My son knows a lot about tech.
Many tech companies are in California.

spanish.definition: Palabra informal para la tecnología.

definition: A large house, often near the ocean or for vacations.
examples: We rented a villa near the beach.
Their villa has a big pool.
She owns a villa in Italy.

spanish.definition: Casa grande, a menudo cerca del mar o para vacaciones.

definition: Thinking that people want to hurt you or are against you, without a good reason.
examples: You're just being paranoid.
He's paranoid that someone is following him.
She got paranoid about her health.

spanish.definition: Que piensa sin razón que la gente quiere hacerle daño.

definition: A model of a person; an informal word for a stupid person.
examples: The shirt was on a dummy in the store window.
Don't be a dummy!
They used a dummy to test the car.

spanish.definition: Modelo de una persona; palabra informal para alguien tonto.

definition: The lowest sounds in music; a guitar that makes low sounds.
examples: He plays bass in a rock band.
Turn down the bass, please.
I can hear the bass from the next room.

spanish.definition: Los sonidos más graves de la música; guitarra de sonidos graves.

definition: The state of being awake and knowing what is around you.
examples: He lost consciousness after the accident.
She slowly came back to consciousness.
Doctors are still studying human consciousness.

spanish.definition: Estado de estar despierto y saber qué hay alrededor.

definition: Extremely good; wonderful.
examples: We had a marvelous time in Hawaii.
What a marvelous idea!
She's a marvelous cook.

spanish.definition: Extremadamente bueno.

definition: A child or person who behaves badly but in a funny way.
examples: That little rascal took my hat.
Come here, you rascal!
My grandson is a real rascal.

spanish.definition: Niño o persona que se porta mal de manera graciosa.

definition: A serious disease that spreads quickly and kills many people.
examples: The plague killed many people in Europe.
They read a book about the plague.
He's avoiding me like the plague.

spanish.definition: Enfermedad grave que se extiende rápido y mata a muchos.

definition: One part of a country's economy or of an area.
examples: She works in the public sector.
The tech sector is growing fast.
The private sector created new jobs.

spanish.definition: Parte de la economía de un país o de un área.

definition: A vehicle with wheels that is pulled by horses.
examples: The queen arrived in a carriage.
We took a carriage ride through the park.
Two white horses pulled the carriage.

spanish.definition: Vehículo con ruedas tirado por caballos.

definition: A room under a house, often used to keep things.
examples: We keep the wine in the cellar.
It's cold and dark in the cellar.
He went down to the cellar for some potatoes.

spanish.definition: Cuarto debajo de una casa, usado para guardar cosas.

definition: The pointed end of something; extra money for a waiter; useful advice.
examples: We left a good tip for the waiter.
Do you have any tips for learning English?
Don't forget to tip the driver.

spanish.definition: Extremo de algo; dinero extra para un mesero; consejo útil.

definition: Something that someone does, often something good.
examples: He did a good deed today.
She's known for her kind deeds.
They are proud of his brave deed.

spanish.definition: Algo que alguien hace, a menudo algo bueno.

definition: Something that looks real but is not; a false idea.
examples: The water on the road is just an illusion.
Mirrors create the illusion of more space.
He has no illusions about his chances.

spanish.definition: Algo que parece real pero no lo es; idea falsa.

definition: A building with a machine for making flour; a factory.
examples: The old mill is next to the river.
My grandfather worked in a steel mill.
They take the grain to the mill.

spanish.definition: Edificio con máquina para hacer harina; fábrica.

definition: A small animal that lives under the ground; a small dark spot on the skin.
examples: A mole made holes in our yard.
She has a small mole on her face.
Moles can't see very well.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño que vive bajo tierra; manchita oscura en la piel.

definition: Causing death; causing very bad results.
examples: There was a fatal accident on the highway.
The disease can be fatal.
That was a fatal mistake.

spanish.definition: Que causa la muerte o resultados muy malos.

definition: A person who gets money or property when someone dies.
examples: He's the only heir to the family business.
She's the heir to a large fortune.
The king had no heir.

spanish.definition: Persona que recibe dinero o bienes cuando alguien muere.

definition: How long something is.
examples: What's the length of this table?
The length of the movie is two hours.
She cut her hair to shoulder length.

spanish.definition: Lo largo que es algo.

definition: A doctor who takes care of your teeth.
examples: I have to go to the dentist tomorrow.
My dentist fixed my tooth.
She's afraid of the dentist.

spanish.definition: Médico que cuida tus dientes.

definition: A company or business; a big new project.
examples: They started a small enterprise.
It's a family enterprise.
This new enterprise needs a lot of money.

spanish.definition: Compañía o negocio; proyecto grande y nuevo.

definition: A sports competition with many players or teams.
examples: Our team won the tennis tournament.
He plays in a chess tournament every year.
The tournament starts on Friday.

spanish.definition: Competencia deportiva con muchos jugadores o equipos.

definition: To cook meat or vegetables in an oven; meat cooked in this way.
examples: We roast a turkey every Thanksgiving.
My mother made a beef roast for dinner.
I love roast chicken with potatoes.

spanish.definition: Cocinar carne o verduras en el horno; carne cocinada así.

definition: A group of pages on the internet.
examples: You can buy tickets on our website.
I found this recipe on a website.
The company has a new website.

spanish.definition: Grupo de páginas en internet.

definition: A lot of water that covers land that is usually dry; to cover with water.
examples: The flood destroyed many homes.
The river flooded the town.
Heavy rain can cause floods.

spanish.definition: Mucha agua que cubre tierra normalmente seca; cubrir de agua.

definition: A place on the coast where ships stay safely.
examples: The boats are in the harbor.
We walked along the harbor at sunset.
The ship left the harbor this morning.

spanish.definition: Lugar en la costa donde los barcos están seguros.

definition: A very large and expensive house.
examples: The actor lives in a mansion in Beverly Hills.
The mansion has twenty rooms.
They bought an old mansion.

spanish.definition: Casa muy grande y cara.

definition: A public sale where things go to the person who offers the most money.
examples: He bought the painting at an auction.
They auctioned the old cars.
The auction starts at ten o'clock.

spanish.definition: Venta pública donde las cosas son para quien ofrece más dinero.

definition: A man who has never married; a first university degree.
examples: He's still a bachelor at forty.
She has a bachelor's degree in biology.
We had a party for the bachelor.

spanish.definition: Hombre que nunca se ha casado; primer título universitario.

definition: Having ghosts in it.
examples: People say this house is haunted.
We visited a haunted hotel.
The kids are afraid of the haunted castle.

spanish.definition: Que tiene fantasmas.

definition: Not able to pay attention to something.
examples: He's distracted by his phone.
I got distracted and burned the rice.
She seems distracted today.

spanish.definition: Que no puede prestar atención a algo.

definition: To talk with someone to reach an agreement.
examples: We negotiated a better price.
The two countries will negotiate next week.
You can always negotiate your salary.

spanish.definition: Hablar con alguien para llegar a un acuerdo.

definition: An informal word for champion.
examples: He's the new boxing champ.
Good job, champ!
She's the champ of our chess club.

spanish.definition: Palabra informal para campeón.

definition: A drink made by mixing alcohol with juice or other drinks.
examples: She ordered a cocktail at the bar.
We had cocktails before dinner.
This fruit cocktail is delicious.

spanish.definition: Bebida con alcohol mezclado con jugo u otras bebidas.

definition: An animal like a small horse with long ears.
examples: The donkey carried the bags up the hill.
My uncle has a donkey on his farm.
That donkey doesn't want to move.

spanish.definition: Animal como un caballo pequeño con orejas largas.

definition: The most important male servant in a rich house.
examples: The butler opened the door.
They have a butler and a cook.
The butler brought the tea.

spanish.definition: El sirviente principal en una casa rica.

definition: Feeling that everything is turning and you may fall.
examples: I feel dizzy when I stand up.
The heat made her dizzy.
He got dizzy on the ride.

spanish.definition: Que siente que todo da vueltas y puede caerse.

definition: A mention of something; a letter about a person from a past boss.
examples: I need a reference from my last job.
He made a reference to his childhood.
Keep this book for reference.

spanish.definition: Mención de algo; carta sobre una persona de un jefe anterior.

definition: A person who hurts or scares weaker people; to hurt or scare them.
examples: The school bully took his lunch money.
Don't bully your little brother.
She was bullied at her old school.

spanish.definition: Persona que lastima o asusta a los más débiles; hacer esto.

definition: To fall down suddenly.
examples: The old bridge collapsed.
He collapsed on the floor.
The collapse of the building scared everyone.

spanish.definition: Caer de repente.

definition: The smallest amount possible or allowed.
examples: The minimum age is eighteen.
She earns the minimum wage.
You need a minimum of three players.

spanish.definition: La cantidad más pequeña posible o permitida.

definition: The society and culture of a people or a place.
examples: We studied the ancient civilizations of Egypt.
The Maya civilization was very advanced.
After a week in the forest, we returned to civilization.

spanish.definition: La sociedad y cultura de un pueblo o lugar.

definition: Having a lot of money.
examples: She comes from a wealthy family.
He's a wealthy businessman.
Only wealthy people live here.

spanish.definition: Que tiene mucho dinero.

definition: A medical condition of feeling very sad for a long time.
examples: He's being treated for depression.
Depression is a real illness.
She went through a long depression.

spanish.definition: Enfermedad de sentirse muy triste por mucho tiempo.

definition: The regular rising and falling of the ocean.
examples: The tide is coming in.
You can walk there at low tide.
The high tide covered the beach.

spanish.definition: La subida y bajada regular del mar.

definition: A secret word you need to enter a computer or an account.
examples: I forgot my password.
What's the Wi-Fi password?
Don't share your password with anyone.

spanish.definition: Palabra secreta para entrar a una computadora o cuenta.

definition: To make a liquid fall out of its container by accident.
examples: I spilled coffee on my shirt.
Be careful not to spill your milk.
Clean up that spill, please.

spanish.definition: Hacer caer un líquido de su recipiente sin querer.

definition: Tired and wanting to sleep.
examples: I feel sleepy after lunch.
The baby is getting sleepy.
It's a sleepy little town.

spanish.definition: Cansado y con ganas de dormir.

definition: Not moving or changing; noise on a radio.
examples: Prices stayed static last year.
I can only hear static on the radio.
My hair is full of static.

spanish.definition: Que no se mueve o cambia; ruido en una radio.

definition: A small group of words.
examples: Learn some useful phrases before your trip.
What does this phrase mean?
He repeated the same phrase again and again.

spanish.definition: Grupo pequeño de palabras.

definition: A good opinion of something; official permission.
examples: We need the boss's approval.
She wanted her father's approval.
The plan got approval from the city.

spanish.definition: Buena opinión de algo; permiso oficial.

definition: A small amount of food between meals; to eat one.
examples: I had a snack after school.
Fruit is a healthy snack.
Try not to snack late at night.

spanish.definition: Poca comida entre las comidas; comerla.

definition: A valuable stone, like a diamond.
examples: The crown is full of jewels.
She keeps her jewels in a small box.
The thief stole a famous jewel.

spanish.definition: Piedra valiosa, como un diamante.

definition: The soft part on each side of your face.
examples: She kissed him on the cheek.
Tears ran down her cheeks.
The cold made his cheeks red.

spanish.definition: Parte suave a cada lado de la cara.

definition: A long narrow hole next to a road; to leave someone or something.
examples: The car went into the ditch.
They dug a ditch along the field.
She ditched her date at the movies.

spanish.definition: Hueco largo y estrecho junto a un camino; dejar a alguien o algo.

definition: An American coin worth ten cents.
examples: Do you have a dime?
I found a dime on the floor.
Two nickels make a dime.

spanish.definition: Moneda estadounidense de diez centavos.

definition: Connected to the home or to your own country.
examples: Dogs and cats are domestic animals.
This is a domestic flight.
She does all the domestic work.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el hogar o con tu propio país.

definition: To laugh quietly.
examples: He chuckled at the joke.
She read the note and chuckled.
He gave a little chuckle.

spanish.definition: Reír en voz baja.

definition: To get into a computer without permission; a clever way to do something.
examples: Someone hacked my email.
They hacked into the bank's computers.
Here's a simple kitchen hack.

spanish.definition: Entrar a una computadora sin permiso; manera lista de hacer algo.

definition: Money asked for to free a person who is held by criminals.
examples: They paid a large ransom for the boy.
The kidnappers asked for a ransom.
The family received a ransom note.

spanish.definition: Dinero pedido para liberar a alguien retenido por criminales.

definition: A woman who brings food to tables in a restaurant.
examples: The waitress brought our drinks.
She works as a waitress on weekends.
Ask the waitress for the check.

spanish.definition: Mujer que lleva comida a las mesas de un restaurante.

definition: A wish to hurt or annoy someone; in spite of means although something happens.
examples: We went out in spite of the rain.
He did it out of spite.
In spite of her age, she runs every day.

spanish.definition: Deseo de herir o molestar a alguien; in spite of significa a pesar de.

definition: A person who fights against a government or against the rules.
examples: The rebels took control of the city.
He was a rebel in high school.
She's a rebel who never follows the rules.

spanish.definition: Persona que lucha contra un gobierno o contra las reglas.

definition: Lucky.
examples: I'm fortunate to have good friends.
We were fortunate to find a hotel.
He helps people who are less fortunate.

spanish.definition: Con suerte.

definition: A person who stays alive after something dangerous.
examples: There were no survivors of the crash.
She's a cancer survivor.
They found a survivor after the earthquake.

spanish.definition: Persona que sigue viva después de algo peligroso.

definition: To answer; an answer.
examples: She didn't reply to my email.
I'm waiting for a reply.
He replied with a smile.

spanish.definition: Contestar; una respuesta.
